story.text: 그날은 유난히 게이트 앞이 시끄러웠다. 사람들이 한쪽으로 몰려들며 휴대폰을 들어 올리고 있었다.
story.reading: geu-nal-eun yu-nan-hi ge-i-teu ap-i si-kkeu-reo-woss-da. sa-ram-deul-i han-jjog-eu-ro mol-lyeo-deul-myeo hyu-dae-pon-eul deul-eo ol-li-go iss-eoss-da.
story.en: That day, the area in front of the gate was unusually loud. People were crowding toward one side, phones raised.

story.text: '저기 좀 봐요, 실물이다!' 누군가 외치는 소리에 하늘은 별생각 없이 고개를 돌렸다가, 그대로 놀랐다. 그 한가운데 서 있는 얼굴이, 낯익은 그 얼굴이었다.
story.reading: 'jeo-gi jom bwa-yo, sil-mul-i-da!' nu-gun-ga oe-chi-neun so-ri-e ha-neul-eun byeol-saeng-gag eobs-i go-gae-reul dol-lyeoss-da-ga, geu-dae-ro nol-lass-da. geu han-ga-un-de seo iss-neun eol-gul-i, nach-ig-eun geu eol-gul-i-eoss-da.
story.en: 'Look over there, it's really her!' Someone shouted, and Haneul turned his head without much thought — only to be genuinely surprised. Standing right in the middle of it all was that face. The familiar one.

story.text: 순식간에 몰려든 사람들은 다들 손에 앨범이나 포토카드를 쥐고 있었다. 하늘은 그제서야 깨달았다. 이 사람들이 전부, 그녀의 팬이라는 걸.
story.reading: sun-sik-gan-e mol-lyeo-deun sa-ram-deul-eun da-deul son-e ael-beom-i-na po-to-ka-deu-reul jwi-go iss-eoss-da. ha-neul-eun geu-je-seo-ya kkae-dal-ass-da. i sa-ram-deul-i jeon-bu, geu-nyeo-ui paen-i-ra-neun geol.
story.en: The people who'd gathered in an instant were all clutching albums or photocards. Only then did Haneul realize — every single one of them was her fan.

story.text: 직원 하나가 다가와 다급하게 말했다. '손님, 공항에서 이렇게 알아보는 사람이 많으면 저희 쪽에서 안전 요원 붙여드릴게요.' 하늘은 그 말을 듣고서야 상황을 이해했다.
story.reading: jig-won ha-na-ga da-ga-wa da-geub-ha-ge mal-haess-da. 'son-nim, gong-hang-e-seo i-reoh-ge al-a-bo-neun sa-ram-i man-eu-myeon jeo-hui jjog-e-seo an-jeon yo-won but-yeo-deu-ril-ge-yo.' ha-neul-eun geu mal-eul deut-go-seo-ya sang-hwang-eul i-hae-haess-da.
story.en: A staff member hurried over. 'Ma'am, when this many people recognize you at the airport, we usually assign security.' Only then did Haneul fully understand the situation.

story.text: 하늘은 애써 담담한 척 물었다. '…이렇게 유명한 사람인 줄 몰랐어요.' 목소리는 평소와 같았지만, 손끝이 미세하게 떨리고 있었다.
story.reading: ha-neul-eun ae-sseo dam-dam-han cheok mul-eoss-da. '…i-reoh-ge yu-myeong-han sa-ram-in jul mol-lass-eo-yo.' mok-so-ri-neun pyeong-so-wa gat-ass-ji-man, son-kkeut-i mi-se-ha-ge tteol-li-go iss-eoss-da.
story.en: Haneul asked, trying hard to sound unbothered. '...I didn't know you were this famous.' His voice was steady, as usual — but his fingertips were trembling, just slightly.

story.text: 겨우 소란이 가라앉고 게이트 안으로 들어온 뒤에도, 그는 한참 동안 아무 말이 없었다. 머릿속이 뒤죽박죽이었다.
story.reading: gyeo-u so-ran-i ga-ra-anj-go ge-i-teu an-eu-ro deul-eo-on dwi-e-do, geu-neun han-cham dong-an a-mu mal-i eobs-eoss-da. meo-rit-sog-i dwi-juk-bak-jug-i-eoss-da.
story.en: Even after the commotion finally died down and they made it inside the gate, he stayed silent for a long while. His head was a mess.

story.text: '…괜찮아요.' 손님이 웃으며 건넨 말에, 하늘은 뒤늦게 정신을 차리고 대답했다. '그게, 안 괜찮은 건 저인 것 같은데요.' 처음으로, 그는 뭘 어떻게 해야 할지 몰랐다.
story.reading: '…gwaen-chan-a-yo.' son-nim-i us-eu-myeo geon-nen mal-e, ha-neul-eun dwi-neuk-ge jeong-sin-eul cha-ri-go dae-dab-haess-da. 'geu-ge, an gwaen-chan-eun geon jeo-in geot gat-eun-de-yo.' cheo-eum-eu-ro, geu-neun mwol eo-tteoh-ge hae-ya hal-ji mol-lass-da.
story.en: '...It's okay.' When she said that with a smile, Haneul finally snapped out of it and answered. 'I think I'm the one who's not okay, here.' For the first time, he had no idea what to do.

words.example_en: Many fans gathered at the airport.
People recognized her at a glance.
She was far more famous than he thought.
After a brief commotion, it grew quiet again.
He was greatly surprised by the news.

sentences.en: Fans all crowded in at once at the airport.
People recognized her at a glance.
I didn't know she was this famous.
I waited until the commotion died down.
I was greatly surprised by that fact.
